notes: This contract records Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 timestamped directed-interaction slice: one non-regional directed target, constrained and nonconstrained recipients captured in a federation-owned recipient ledger, TSO queueing before Time Advance Grant for the constrained recipient, callback-gated delivery, official timestamp/order/retraction callback fields, lower-bound validation, pending-fanout suppression, a legal post-delivery Request Retraction callback for the delivered nonconstrained recipient, and a narrow save/restore regression that prevents a discarded post-save retraction designator from aliasing a fresh post-restore directed message. A target-departure regression queues the directed interaction at time 7 and a target deletion at time 6: the time-6 removal callback commits target departure, and the later time-7 callback boundary suppresses the stale directed payload before its grant. Connection-loss regressions retain an accepted time-6 directed payload through a regulating producer's forced resignation: one reaches a survivor already awaiting the matching grant, and a DELETE_OBJECTS target collision retains the target until a survivor later opens the time-6 boundary; in both cases the cutoff marker is required and the selector remains live at callback time. A late directed unsubscription suppresses the callback without leaving a false pending ledger state that would strand the distinct automatic removal. The dedicated selector regression covers an owner/default recipient, a known non-owner/default recipient, a known non-owner/universal recipient, a universal-to-by-ownership change before TSO grant, and an unsubscription before a later grant. The direct selector predicate remains source-traced through the generic §5.12 candidate because the Lab has no granular candidate (RL-028); the §5.13 postcondition candidate's exported clause-5.14.3 ownership is the cross-page error recorded in RL-080. It does not claim directed DDM, alternate advance modes, complete save/restore semantics, remote transport, catalog evidence, or conformance.
